test_intersection: test the RangeIndex.intersection method for overlapping and non-overlapping ranges with various dtypes and sort options
test_union: test the RangeIndex.union method for combining two ranges with same and different steps, sorted and unsorted
test_difference: test the RangeIndex.difference method for subtracting one range from another with sort and step variations
test_symmetric_difference: test the RangeIndex.symmetric_difference method for elements in either range but not both
test_range_difference_hypothesis: test the RangeIndex.difference method with Hypothesis property-based tests across random start, stop, and step values
